participants.name: Darwin Gödel Machine
participants.description: Self-improving coding-agent framework. Its evolving artifact is an agent code bundle, evaluated on coding episodes, rather than a universal single-file task solution.
limitations: The source revision is registered; no Arena native runner or evaluation adapter is implemented.
An agent-bundle and coding-episode evaluation protocol is required before native DGM comparisons.
Registration does not make DGM compatible with all task-library problems.

participants.name: SCiEL
participants.description: Evolutionary research framework with hypothesis, conclusion, reflection, research cells and reusable research tools. The existing journal observer is separate from a native Arena execution adapter.
limitations: Arena does not yet launch the native SCiEL loop or supply canonical evaluation receipts.
Native framework features do not imply that their Arena control adapters are implemented.
The separate read-only SCiEL observer does not execute tasks or frameworks.

participants.name: ShinkaEvolve
participants.description: Sakana AI's evolutionary program-search framework. Integration is planned around its native whole-run loop and a canonical evaluator callback.
limitations: The source revision is registered; no Arena native runner or evaluation adapter is implemented.
Task compatibility and runtime readiness have not been measured by Arena.
